SELECT o.org_id, o.parent_org_id, o.org_code, o.org_name, o.org_type, o.org_path, o.org_level, o.manager_person_id, o.contact_phone, o.status, o.sort_no, o.created_time, o.remark, p.person_name as manager_name, creator.account_display as created_name FROM exp_org_unit o LEFT JOIN exp_person p ON o.manager_person_id = p.person_id LEFT JOIN exp_account creator ON o.created_by = creator.account_id
AND o.org_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{orgCode}, '%')
AND o.org_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{orgName}, '%')
ORDER BY o.sort_no ASC, o.created_time DESC

SELECT o.org_id, o.parent_org_id, o.org_code, o.org_name, o.org_type, o.org_path, o.org_level, o.manager_person_id, o.contact_phone, o.address, o.status, o.sort_no, o.created_time, o.updated_time, o.remark, p.person_name as manager_name, creator.account_display as created_name FROM exp_org_unit o LEFT JOIN exp_person p ON o.manager_person_id = p.person_id LEFT JOIN exp_account creator ON o.created_by = creator.account_id WHERE o.org_id = #{orgId}

SELECT org_id, parent_org_id, org_code, org_name, org_type, org_path, org_level, manager_person_id, contact_phone, address, status, sort_no, created_by, created_time, updated_time, remark FROM exp_org_unit WHERE parent_org_id = #{parentOrgId} ORDER BY sort_no ASC, created_time DESC

SELECT org_id, parent_org_id, org_code, org_name, org_type, org_path, org_level, manager_person_id, contact_phone, address, status, sort_no, created_by, created_time, updated_time, remark FROM exp_org_unit
1 = 0
org_path IS NULL OR org_path LIKE '/%'
org_path LIKE CONCAT(#{orgPath}, '/%')
ORDER BY org_path ASC, sort_no ASC
